key.name: looks
key.description: JSON array of looks. Each look stores a wallpaper and optional theme settings; null fields are left unchanged when the look is applied.

key.name: active-look
key.summary: ID of the look that was applied last

key.name: first-run-done
key.summary: Whether the “Original” look has been created

key.name: transition-duration
key.summary: Duration of the circle transition in milliseconds

key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show the button in the top bar

key.name: gtk4-link
key.summary: GTK4 theme links created by the extension
key.description: JSON object listing the files in ~/.config/gtk-4.0 that are symlinks owned by this extension.

key.name: apply-request
key.summary: Request from the preferences to apply a look
key.description: JSON object with the look ID and a nonce. Written by the preferences window, handled by the shell.
